name: hamster
description: Ask Hamster about your team’s work and turn briefs into shipped code without leaving your AI coding tool.

interface.longDescription: Ask Hamster what your team is building, why decisions were made, and what needs attention. In Codex, work through existing brief plans to build, test, and review code, with your approval before pushing or opening a pull request. In ChatGPT, Hamster uses its hosted MCP server; skills that run the CLI and git work locally in Codex, not ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Set up Hamster in this repository with $hamster:setup
I'm changing auth middleware on this branch. Which workspace decisions apply?
List actionable Briefs from the local projection and ship one
